use_ao_attributes_manager: use the AOAttributesManager to access ambient occlusion attributes from the Habitat-Sim simulator
use_asset_attributes_manager: use the AssetAttributesManager to manage asset attributes within the Habitat-Sim scene graph
use_object_attributes_manager: use the ObjectAttributesManager to access and manage object attributes in a Habitat-Sim simulation
use_pbr_shader_attributes_manager: use the PbrShaderAttributesManager to manage physically-based rendering shader attributes in Habitat-Sim
use_physics_attributes_manager: use the PhysicsAttributesManager to access physics-related attributes for objects in Habitat-Sim
